bug_semantics: CVE-2025-50736 / GHSA-pfrv-63w8-q7rq claim that PDFMathTranslate v1.9.9 (pip pdf2zh) performs an unvalidated HTTP 302 open redirect when an attacker supplies an external URL as the file parameter to /gradio_api (researcher write-up: GET /gradio_api/file=<http(s) URL> returns 302 Location to that URL). That route and 302 are Gradio framework behavior, not application code. Gradio 5 mounts APIRouter(prefix='/gradio_api') and implements GET/HEAD /file={path_or_url}; if client_utils.is_http_url_like(path_or_url) it returns RedirectResponse(url=path_or_url, status_code=302). The same mechanism is independently tracked as a Gradio CWE-601 (CVE-2024-8021 /file= encoding redirect; CVE-2026-59806 file_fetch /gradio_api/file= open redirect+SSRF, fixed in Gradio 6.20.0). This repository never registers /gradio_api/file= or issues that redirect; it only calls demo.launch() from pdf2zh/gui.py.
flaw_origin: Upstream Gradio PR #2256 member 500bcca42f406dc8ac30c601208828af81fc12c1 first adds the URL redirect branch. PDFMathTranslate mounts the dependency route and remains unpatched while pinning a Gradio range that excludes fixed 6.20.0.

reasoning: Vulnerability-first: the claimed bug is CWE-601 open redirect on GET /gradio_api/file=<external URL> returning HTTP 302 Location to that URL in PDFMathTranslate v1.9.9. CVE.org remains PUBLISHED (not rejected) and GHSA withdrawn_at is null, so this is not a withdrawn-CVE close; it is a false-positive attribution. Mechanism check against first-party code: at tag v1.9.9 and on current main, pdf2zh has no /gradio_api or /file= route and never constructs RedirectResponse. The GUI is a stock Gradio Blocks app launched from pdf2zh/gui.py:setup_gui. The researcher-named endpoint is Gradio's built-in file() route under API_PREFIX='/gradio_api', which in Gradio 5.x (including 5.29.0, in the unpinned-gradio window of v1.9.9) 302-redirects any http(s)-like path_or_url. That is the same framework defect later given CVE-2026-59806 and patched in Gradio 6.20.0; an earlier sibling is CVE-2024-8021. BIC search therefore cannot land in this repository: there are no vulnerable lines to git log -L/-S onto. Launching Gradio (3fad3b31...) is not a BIC. AI authorship is not judged because there is no first-party BIC. Verdict FALSE_POSITIVE: the advisory is wrong as a PDFMathTranslate/pdf2zh application vulnerability; it restates a Gradio framework open redirect as if it were first-party code.
remaining_gap: PDFMathTranslate has no direct-fix commit or fixed release. Upstream Gradio direct fix 1c5c53842df9c2750552d85c19a92e7e732cff3f ships in 6.20.0.

unpatched.reason: The consumer still mounts the vulnerable dependency route and excludes the fixed upstream release.

potential_fix.approach: Upgrade the Gradio dependency to 6.20.0 or later and verify the mounted file route.
potential_fix.rationale: Upstream 1c5c53842df9c2750552d85c19a92e7e732cff3f replaces the arbitrary redirect with a secure streamed response.
